en.name: Zicheng Wang
en.description: Zicheng Wang — electrical engineering undergraduate exploring power-system dynamics, interpretable models, and AI-assisted simulation.
en.headline: Making sense of a changing grid.
en.intro: I’m an undergraduate in Electrical Engineering and Automation at Changsha University of Science and Technology. I study how renewable generation interacts with the grid, through physical models, equivalent circuits, and machine learning.
en.portrait_caption: A little curiosity, in and out of the lab.
en.research_intro: My work starts with the dynamics of converter-based power systems. I’m interested in models that are useful for analysis and remain connected to physical meaning.

research.title: Power-system dynamics
research.text: Modeling renewable-rich systems and understanding oscillations, interactions, and weakly damped components.

research.title: Interpretable models
research.text: PMSG impedance and admittance, equivalent-circuit representations, and model reduction across operating points.

research.title: Learning & simulation
research.text: Using machine learning for model prediction, and exploring AI-assisted engineering workflows.

en.papers_intro: Two first-author papers on PMSG modeling and prediction across operating conditions.
en.project_intro: Models, tools, and experiments from my research workflow.
en.background_intro: From applied statistics to electrical engineering, I’ve kept an interest in both physical reasoning and data.

education.title: Electrical Engineering and Automation
education.text: Changsha University of Science and Technology · Undergraduate, expected June 2027

education.title: Applied Statistics
education.text: Coursework at Changsha University of Science and Technology, before transferring to electrical engineering.

en.outside: Away from the screen, I enjoy hiking, cycling, cooking, and video editing.
en.contact_text: Interested in power-system modeling, renewable energy, or AI-assisted engineering? I’m always glad to learn from a thoughtful conversation.
en.notebook_intro: Notes on models, methods, and things I’m learning along the way.

zh.name: 王子成
zh.description: 王子成的个人主页。长沙理工大学电气工程本科生，关注新能源电力系统、可解释建模与 AI 辅助仿真。
zh.eyebrow: 电气工程 · 中国长沙
zh.headline: 理解变化中的电网。
zh.intro: 我是长沙理工大学电气工程及其自动化专业的本科生。我从物理模型、等效电路和机器学习出发，研究新能源发电设备与电网之间的动态交互。
zh.current: 近期正在探索 AI 辅助的电力系统仿真。
zh.portrait_caption: 在研究与生活里，保持一点好奇。
zh.research_title: 从物理出发，探索新的可能。
zh.research_intro: 我的研究从电力电子化电力系统的动态特性出发，希望建立既有助于分析、又保留物理含义的模型。

research.title: 电力系统动态
research.text: 面向高比例新能源电力系统建模，理解系统振荡、设备交互与弱阻尼环节。

research.title: 可解释建模
research.text: 围绕 PMSG 阻抗与导纳，研究等效电路表示及不同运行工况下的模型降阶。

research.title: 机器学习与仿真
research.text: 利用机器学习开展模型预测，并探索 AI 辅助的工程仿真工作流。

zh.papers_intro: 两篇第一作者论文，围绕不同运行工况下的 PMSG 建模与预测。
zh.project_intro: 研究过程中积累的模型、工具与探索。
zh.background_intro: 从应用统计学走向电气工程，我一直对物理推理与数据方法的结合保持兴趣。

papers.title: Admittance Prediction for PMSG via Dimensionality-Reduced Equivalent Circuits and Support Vector Machines

summary.en: Reduced equivalent circuits and support vector machines for predicting PMSG admittance across operating points.
summary.zh: 结合降维等效电路与支持向量机，预测不同运行工况下的 PMSG 导纳。

papers.title: Impedance Prediction of PMSG in Circuit Form Under Variable Operating Points

summary.en: An equivalent-circuit approach to PMSG impedance prediction. Presented orally in English at ACPEE 2026, Macau.
summary.zh: 以等效电路形式开展 PMSG 变工况阻抗预测，于澳门 ACPEE 2026 进行英文口头报告。

title.en: From equations to a small-signal model
title.zh: 从电气方程到小信号模型

text.en: PMSG electrical modeling and linearization: a starting point for studying device dynamics.
text.zh: PMSG 电气模型与线性化，为理解设备动态特性建立模型基础。

text.en: From state-space models to impedance matrices, vector fitting, and equivalent-circuit elements.
text.zh: 从状态空间模型到阻抗矩阵，经矢量拟合得到等效电路元件。

text.en: Ongoing improvements in my personal working fork of PowerMCP, exploring AI interaction with engineering simulation.
text.zh: 在 PowerMCP 个人工作分支中持续探索与改进，连接 AI 与工程仿真。
